# LOKI 3PL

LOKI 3PL is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. LOKI 3PL is a company that provides 3PL logistics, ecommerce fulfillment, and warehousing services. They have 11 US centers and own fleet and warehouses. They offer fast, asset-based solutions. LOKI 3PL employs 12 people (+100.0% YoY, +6 people). Headquartered in Edison, New Jersey, United States, with offices in Newark, East Brunswick, Pooler, and Dayton. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Colombia, and India.

## About

We are LOKI 3PL, a modern 3PL built for B2B and e-commerce. Our founder, Rodney Galeano, spent a decade leading large U.S. warehouse networks for multiple Fortune 500s before launching an owner-led, customer-centric alternative. Transparent pricing, responsive service, and real access to leadership. HQ hub in East Brunswick, NJ with 50,000 square feet and 50+ clients served. Let’s see how we stack up for your operation.

# Logos Logistics, Inc.

Logos Logistics, Inc. is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Logos Logistics is a 3PL service provider in Michigan, Midwest that offers top third-party logistics services including warehousing, fulfillment, automotive logistics, freight brokerage & more. Logos Logistics, Inc. employs 61 people (+27.1% YoY, +13 people), founded in 2008. Headquartered in Romulus, Michigan, United States, with presence in South Korea. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Indonesia.

## About

Logos Logistics is an asset-based third-party logistics provider delivering integrated warehousing, transportation, fulfillment and contract logistics solutions across the U.S.

Since 2008, we've helped businesses simplify complex supply chains through strategically located facilities, asset-based trucking and technology-driven logistics solutions built around visibility, reliability and efficiency.

Our capabilities include:

• 3PL Warehousing
• Asset-Based Trucking & Transportation
• Order Fulfillment
• Contract Logistics
• Freight Brokerage & Freight Forwarding
• Cross-Docking & Distribution
• Inventory Management
• Kitting, Repacking & Value-Added Services
• Reverse Logistics

We support industries including automotive and auto parts, tires, batteries and electronics, e-commerce, consumer and retail, food and beverage, industrial and aerospace, and packaging.

From storage and inventory management to final delivery, Logos gives businesses one logistics partner to keep products moving.
